mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 7 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 10, low 4.

Italian side Como thrashed Lens 9-1 in the Champions League, Cesc Fabregas urged his players to stay grounded.

Manchester City edged RB Leipzig 3-2 in a dramatic Champions League group match.

Arsenal secured a 2-1 away win over Slavia Prague in the Champions League.

After more than 150 days of street protests, Albanian students will shift to a new schedule of two nationwide strikes each week, with the next demonstration set for Nov. 7.

U.S. Senate candidate JD Vance is moving to distance himself politically from former President Donald Trump following Republican losses in the midterm elections.
